gates.requirement: Every interface process binds one existing workspace under one to sixteen explicit resolved allowed roots.
MCP uses stdio by default; optional Streamable HTTP binds only to 127.0.0.1 with DNS-rebinding protection, a bounded request body, and no remote-origin allowance.
The MCP registry is fixed to inspect, lineage, verify, workbench snapshot, relation comparison, and transduction; payload text cannot register or select another tool.
Every tool maps to one versioned Python operation and returns a validated OperationResult with its exact operation status and reason.
Inspect, lineage, verify, and workbench snapshot are read-only; they never create domain records, repair state, or merge semantic occurrences.
Relation comparison and transduction require both human-controlled server enablement and human_approved=true on the individual call.
Record counts, lineage depth, input bytes, URL bytes, and output groups remain within declared process bounds.
The HTTP workbench is loopback-only, GET/HEAD-only, no-store, and presents bounded lineage, disagreement, mappings, claims, and evidence.
Workbench and skill accounts distinguish measurement, inference, render, source, execution evidence, derived claims, and human report.
A candidate is never presented as a DSQ without recorded task-bound qualification and complete bounded refinement evidence.
P13 performs no external network or engine execution, playback, model execution, human collection, public projection, or adjacent-checkout write.
The qste-inspection skill is valid, progressively discloses mutation inputs, and cannot expand user authorization or treat tool availability as authority.
